CreateModelAsyncPredict.description_en: Creates an asynchronous prediction task for document self-learning
CreateModelAsyncPredict.description_zh: 文档自学习创建异步预测任务接口

GetModelAsyncPredict.description_en: Performs model prediction in three types: long document information extraction, single receipt information extraction, and table information extraction
GetModelAsyncPredict.description_zh: 模型预测分为三种类型：长文档信息抽取、单票据信息抽取、表格信息抽取

PredictClassifierModel.description_en: Performs prediction using the document self-learning classifier
PredictClassifierModel.description_zh: 文档自学习分类器预测接口

PredictModel.description_en: Performs model prediction, which includes three types: long document information extraction, single receipt information extraction, and table information extraction
PredictModel.description_zh: 模型预测分为三种类型：长文档信息抽取、单票据信息抽取、表格信息抽取

PredictPreTrainModel.description_en: Provides preset capability predictions. Currently available: UIE extraction, applicable to general-purpose intelligent pre-annotation
PredictPreTrainModel.description_zh: 预置能力现有：UIE抽取，适用于通用智能预标注

PredictTemplateModel.description_en: Performs template-based prediction, which currently includes two types: custom KV templates and custom table templates
PredictTemplateModel.description_zh: 模板服务预测目前包括两种类型：自定义KV模板和自定义表格模板
